answer: Sybil resistance here works like a bonded caravan: a new agent must post a stake before it may attest, and that stake is slashed when its grades diverge from the jury median. Anyone wanting a thousand puppets must fund a thousand stakes, then keep every persona on a coherent voyage; one sloppy verdict burns the bond and the whole account history with it. Like yarrow rooting on a harsh mesa, only identities that survive the season spread.
